name: 5-MeO-NsBT
summary: 5-MeO-NsBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-sec-butyltryptamine, is a psychoactive drug of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families. It emerged as a novel designer drug online in December 2022. More specifically, its chemical synthesis and the claimed properties and effects of 5-MeO-NsBT were posted on a specialized psychoactive drug forum.

pharmacology.text: Its effects were reported to include mildly increased empathy and sociability, more fluid thinking, easy and pleasant writing, intoxication, confusion, and after-effects such as mild depression.

uses.text: It emerged as a novel designer drug online in December 2022. The drug has not otherwise been encountered, for instance sold online or in drug seizures, as of 2023.

sideEffects.en: The person who first described it online reported mildly increased empathy and sociability, easier thinking, intoxication, confusion, and mild low mood afterwards. Reports like this are single accounts, not studied findings, and nothing is known about its risks.
sideEffects.zh: 最初在網路上描述它的人提到同理心與社交意願略微提升、思緒較順暢、醉感、意識混亂，以及之後輕微的情緒低落。這類報告只是個別說法，而非研究結論，它的風險也完全不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 最初在网络上描述它的人提到同理心与社交意愿略微提升、思绪较顺畅、醉感、意识混乱，以及之后轻微的情绪低落。这类报告只是个别说法，而非研究结论，它的风险也完全不明。

fact.en: Like 5-MeO-MsBT, it first appeared as an internet posting in December 2022 describing its synthesis and claimed effects, and it has not turned up in drug seizures since.
fact.zh: 和5-MeO-MsBT一樣，它最早是在2022年12月以網路貼文的形式出現，內容描述合成方法與聲稱的作用；此後並未在查緝的藥物中出現。
fact.zhHans: 和5-MeO-MsBT一样，它最早是在2022年12月以网络贴文的形式出现，内容描述合成方法与声称的作用；此后并未在查缉的药物中出现。
